title: Social post crop is position plus zoom, edited in a full-screen drag/pinch editor; export never upscales
context: Users could only slide the crop along the one trimmed axis, so a face cut off at the top of a 4:5 post could not be fixed, and the small preview made it hard to see. The user asked for the usual Facebook/WhatsApp crop UX: drag to move, pinch/scroll to zoom, a big crop view with the trimmed area dimmed.
decision: SocialFocus is { x, y, zoom }: x/y are 0-100 object-position percentages (decimals allowed), zoom is 1-3 (maxSocialZoom), defaulting to 1 when omitted on PATCH and filled on load for older workspaces. cropRect() in packages/contracts/src/social.ts is the single crop geometry for exportFrame, the crop editor (image positioned in % of the crop) and the inline preview (object-fit cover at x% y%, scaled by zoom from the same origin). Output never upscales: zooming in lowers the export size (Instagram 2x = 540x675), shown live in the editor and under the preview. Editing happens in a full-screen (phone) or large side-panel (desktop) dialog with pointer drag, two-finger pinch around the midpoint, wheel/ctrl-wheel zoom around the cursor; Zoom, Horizontal position and Vertical position sliders are the keyboard and single-pointer alternative. Done applies to the unsaved draft; Save post persists it.
consequences: Manifest social.focus now carries zoom and output.crop/size reflect it
x/y are no longer integers; clients should round to 0.01
Postgres snapshots load without migration via upgrade() filling zoom = 1
Real iOS Safari pinch behaviour relies on touch-action: none plus cancelling gesturestart/gesturechange and needs device verification
alternatives_rejected: Drag only along the trimmed axis without zoom: cannot recover a face that is cut because the crop already spans the full width
Dragging directly on the inline preview: too small on phones and conflicts with page scroll and gallery swipes
Upscaling zoomed crops to keep 1080 px output: blurry exports
Capping zoom so the export stays full size: 1086 px wide photos would allow almost no zoom
Keeping the single Crop position slider as the only non-gesture control: it covers one axis only once zoom allows both axes to move
